data.description: Leo Climber is a long yellow caterpillar of steel hoops with a rope net stretched over its back, rising into tall humps and dipping low between them. Children crawl along the net, climb over each hump and come down at the far end, while a yellow ladder partway along gives another way on and off. Climbing the net builds strength, coordination and confidence with height. Its product area is 54' x 18'10" and the safe play area is 59' x 23'10". It needs a long, open strip of ground, such as the edge of a large park or a school field. It is finished in Play Yellow. Under our warranty, galvanised pipe, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope are covered for 3 years. Share your site plan so we can check the fit.

props.pText: The net is play rope fixed to galvanised hoops, and each hoop leg is grouted or installed self-standing. A climber this long needs a level strip, so we check the ground along its full length first. Inspect the net knots and fixings at every service, and lay rubber flooring under the tall humps where children climb highest.
